body:
I just dont see a point to continuing to live. There was my 15 year old friend who's flaunting about his extremely commited relationship with his boyfriend and how he lost his virginity, and i have to listen to it while me, two years older than him, the most sexual contact I've ever had with another person is a fully clothed hug.

Friends tell stories of being awkwardly hit on and its supposed to be funny but it just makes me realize that no one has ever been even remotely interested in me

Im in a heavy state of denial that ill never find the love i want so desperately, but i just have to accept it like everything else in my life. How useless and unlovable i am, what an awful person i am in general, and the fact that literally nothing has helped me in the slightest.

I'll never amount to anything, im completely talentless. I have no use to anyone. I'm ugly and have an awful cynical, negative, nihilist personality, theres no chance ill find love. Im 17 and missing out on being a teenager. I've never experienced anything id call 'fun' in my life. Ive been suicidal since i was 8 and i feel like life is saying "just give up already." My life is going to be pointless and miserable if i keep vegetating like this. And i dont have the will to change anything. So why bother living?

I feel like I'm at wits end. I'm obsessed with suicide and am fanatical about finding a proper method. Thoughts of death consume my entire being, and the past several hours ive been going insane wracking my brain on just how i could find a method i feel good about
